name: Dead Shelter [Early Alpha]
desc:
Survive in a forest filled with zombies and explore different locations!

Build your shelter and explore the forest to gather loot and material to survive the night!

How many nights can you survive?

🚀 New Content ASAP 🚀

"Shift" to sprint
"C" to crouch

Drag items like "Rifle Ammo" to the auto turret to reload, same for Power Generator but with "Power Fuse" instead.

👍 Like the game? ⭐ Favorite it to get updates!

Latest Update (2026/05/12)
- fixed some bugs and updated some systems
- added "Stronghold" a new heavy shelter!

I am currently a solo developer on this project so feedback and support is appreciated!
Game is EARLY ALPHA expect major changes and bugs!

Abusing bugs or cheating to gain advantage may result in a ban.

Zombie survival, explore, build, challenge, fun with friends.

If you like 3008 and Dead Rails you'll probably enjoy this game as well.
